Lily wrote down every idea in a small notebook. Little by little, things began to change. Lily will take part in a baseball match in August. Take the lift to the tenth floor.

People around Lily often share different ideas about the weekend breakfast. The weekend breakfast looked quieter than usual that evening. Lily plans to study science harder this term. For example, westerners eat noodles with a fork.

Kate always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Lily believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. The living room has become an important part of daily life. For example, breakfast is served on the patio.
What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right.
